Chemistry is raising a $500M second fund—double its first $350M, and already faster on returns than most peers. ⏱️

That first fund prioritized early-stage startups and delivered capital back ahead of schedule. The new fund doubles down on that same focus.

Founders backed by Chemistry get bumped to the front of the line for key introductions 🤝
